summary: A/R and A/P Report Sorting - Story 5 - Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location
description:
h2. Summary

Give all six reports the native filter row: As of, Customer (A/R) or Vendor (A/P), Past due and Location, with totals, paging, sort, exports and drill-down following every filter; the reports stay organization-wide.

h2. Context

As a manager of a multi-location shop, I want to narrow the aging to chosen locations so that I can follow up on my own branch.

Prerequisites: User must have 'Reports → Page Access' setting enabled.

Form factor: Desktop only by rule: detailed reports.

h2. Requirements

* S5-R1: Each report's filter row is the native report filter row of the newer reports (Inventory Value, Sales By Customer), in this order on all six reports: the date chip ("As of: 10/15/2026"), the customer chip on the A/R reports or the vendor chip on the A/P reports, the Past due chip, then the Location chip.
* S5-R2: The Location chip and its open menu are the native ones, exactly as on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress: label "Location" with the location pin icon; the menu shows a "Select all" row, a "{N} selected" count, the locations with the ticked ones first, a search box with the placeholder "Search locations" once there are more than 8 locations, and "Clear selection".
* S5-R3: The list offers every location at which the organization has open documents in this report on the as-of date, whatever location the user is signed into and whatever locations they are enrolled in. It is not narrowed by the Location filter, the customer or vendor filter, or the Past due filter; it changes only with the as-of date.
* S5-R4: Each location is named exactly as the location switcher in the top right of ShopView names it, and the Location column uses the same name.
* S5-R5: The filter opens with every location in the list ticked (All locations), so an untouched report shows exactly today's organization-wide rows and totals. "Select all" ticks every location again.
* S5-R6: The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.
* S5-R6a: With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.
* S5-R7: Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.
* S5-R8: On the Summaries, a customer's or vendor's row adds up only their open documents at the chosen locations; a customer or vendor with nothing open there is not listed.
* S5-R9: The chip is shown whenever the report's list (S5-R3) has two or more locations, and always while fewer than all are ticked, so the choice can always be undone.
* S5-R10: The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.
* S5-R10a: Filter choices are not remembered between visits: opening a report from the Reports menu starts on today's as-of date, no customer or vendor, Past due Any, and All locations.
* S5-R11: Clicking a customer or vendor on A/R Summary or A/P Summary opens A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid Invoices with just that customer or vendor ticked, the same as-of date, the same ticked Past due ranges and the same ticked locations.
* S5-R12: The filter does not change who can see what: everyone who can open these reports sees every location's data, as today.
* S5-R13: The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).
* S5-R14: A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.
* S5-R15: The Past due chip and its open menu are the same native checkbox dropdown as Customer and Location: label "Past due", an hourglass icon, an "Any" row, the native line "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow." while none is ticked, then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days", in that order; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Past due: Any" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the range when one is (for example "Past due: 91+ days"), and "Past due: N ranges" when N are. Ticking all four reads "Past due: 4 ranges", not Any, because Any also keeps invoices and bills that are not due yet. The ranges are the reports' own aging buckets: 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and more than 90 days past the due date on the as-of date.
* S5-R16: With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.
* S5-R17: With ranges ticked, A/R Summary and A/P Summary list only the customers or vendors with some open invoice or bill amount in a ticked range; their rows show their full balances in every bucket.
* S5-R18: The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.
* S5-R18a: For the same as-of date, customer or vendor and Location, with Past due on Any, A/R Summary's Totals equal A/R Detail's Open Balance Totals bucket by bucket, and A/P Summary's equal A/P Detail's. The Detail reports' Amount column holds original amounts and is not compared. With a Past due filter they can differ: a Summary keeps the whole row of a customer or vendor that qualifies (Current and credits included), while a Detail report lists only the invoices or bills that qualify, plus every credit.
* S5-R18b: The figures are read fresh on every load: reloading the report shows a payment recorded a moment before. Going away and back inside the app within 30 seconds, without reloading, can show the figures from the earlier visit, as on every screen.
* S5-R19: The ticked customers or vendors and the ticked Past due ranges are kept in the page address like Location (S5-R10).
* S5-N1: If the organization's open documents sit at only one location and it is ticked, the Location chip is not shown.
* S5-N2: A location in a link that is not in the report's Location list (S5-R3), or is not a valid location at all, is ignored: the report loads, the chip reads as if it were not there, and the Location column follows the remaining choice.
* S5-N3: A Past due value in a link that the chip does not offer (for example 5, or "any") is read as Any.
* S5-E1: If a location is chosen and the user then picks a customer or vendor with nothing open there, the report is empty and the Location chip stays visible so the selection can be cleared.
* S5-E2: Switching location in the top right of ShopView while on a report reloads it, as on every other report: the user stays on the report with the same filters and the same rows; the sort returns to the opening order (Story 1), every group collapses and the page returns to the top; which documents link, prompt or show as plain text updates (Story 7).

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* Given any of the six reports, then the filter row reads, in order, "As of: <date>", "Customer: All customers" (A/R) or "Vendor: All vendors" (A/P, truck icon), "Past due: Any" (grey, hourglass icon) and "Location: All locations" (S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15).
* Given the Location chip, then its open menu is exactly Sales By Customer's: "Select all", "{N} selected", the locations with ticked ones first, a "Search locations" box when more than 8, and "Clear selection"; it opens with every location ticked and lists every location with open documents in this report on the as-of date, named as the top-right switcher names it, whatever the user's current or enrolled locations (S5-R2 to S5-R5, S5-R12).
* Given fewer than all locations ticked, then every row, group, subtotal, total, page, sort and export narrows to documents at those locations; the chip reads the location's name, or "Location: N locations"; a Summary row adds up only those documents; given none ticked, then the chip reads "Location: No locations" and the native empty state shows, and a reload opens on All locations (S5-R6 to S5-R8, S5-R6a, S5-R10).
* Given the Customer chip (A/R) or Vendor chip (A/P), then its open menu is exactly Sales By Customer's Customer menu or Inventory Value's Vendor menu (search, shown on the vendor menu only when there are more than 8 vendors, "All customers"/"All vendors", several can be ticked); two ticked read "Customer: 2 customers" and narrow everything to those two (S5-R13).
* Given the Past due menu, then it shows "Any", "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days"; ticking 31-60 and 91+ reads "Past due: 2 ranges"; all four read "Past due: 4 ranges"; none reads grey "Past due: Any" (S5-R15).
* Given 31-60 and 91+ ticked on a transaction report, then only invoices and bills 31 to 60 or more than 90 days past due remain, plus every credit memo, deposit and vendor credit; on a Summary, only accounts with some invoice or bill amount in those ranges remain, at full balances (S5-R16, S5-R17).
* Given any combination of filters, then the Totals row adds up exactly the rows left, on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV; on A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices it follows the customer or vendor filter; with Past due on Any, A/R Summary's Totals equal A/R Detail's Open Balance Totals bucket by bucket (and A/P Summary's equal A/P Detail's), and with Past due ranges ticked they can differ as S5-R18a describes; a payment recorded a moment before shows after a reload (S5-R18, S5-R18a, S5-R18b).
* Given filters set, when the user reloads, goes Back or shares the link, then they are restored; a comma-separated location list is read; a location not in the list or not valid, and an unknown Past due value, are ignored; opening from the Reports menu starts on today, all customers or vendors, Any and every location ticked (S5-R10, S5-R10a, S5-R19, S5-N2, S5-N3).
* Given a customer or vendor clicked on a Summary, then Collection or Unpaid Invoices opens with just that one ticked, the same as-of date, Past due ranges and locations, and the chip names it even when it is beyond the search's first page (S5-R11, S5-R14).
* Given the organization's open documents at only one location and it ticked, then the Location chip is hidden; given a location ticked and then a customer with nothing there, then the report is empty and the chip stays (S5-R9, S5-N1, S5-E1).
* Given the user switches location in the top right while on a report, then the report reloads with the same filters and rows, the opening sort, collapsed groups and the page at the top (S5-E2).

h2. UI/UX

Design: page 4 (Location filter and Location column) and page 7 (Filters and call list)

[A/R and A/P Report Sorting design canvas|https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4]

comments.body:
h1. QA Handoff — SV-11535 Story 5 — filters: As of, customer or vendor, Past due and Location

*QA env:* https://sv11315.qa.shopview.com · *PR:* https://github.com/ShopView/shopview/pull/4262 (branch {{SV-11315-ar-ap-aging-reports}}, head {{8e35ee0d02}})
*Screens:* the filter row on all six aging reports
*Shared notes* (roles, test data, known mismatches): https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11315?focusedCommentId=80616
*Video:* {{sv-11535-filters.mp4}} (recorded before the as-of day fix; the As of steps below are current)

----

h2. What changed

Every report has the same four chips: As of, Customer (A/R) or Vendor (A/P), Past due and Location. The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows left. Choices live in the page address, and a Summary name carries them into A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid.

h2. QA Checklist (do these)

h3. Filter row [S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15]

* Order: As of, Customer (person icon) / Vendor (truck icon), Past due (hourglass), Location. "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" are grey at rest; a choice turns them blue.
* Customer / Vendor menu: search box, "All customers" / "All vendors", "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." The vendor search box shows only with more than 8 vendors. Two ticked → "Customer: 2 customers".
* Past due menu: "Any", helper line, "1-30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91+ days". Two ticked → "Past due: 2 ranges"; all four → "Past due: 4 ranges".

h3. As of [S3-R4]

* [ ] Opens on today at the location. The picker does not offer days after today.
* [ ] Pick a past date → rows, totals and the Location list are as of the end of that day at the location. In DevTools → Network the requests carry {{asOfDate=YYYY-MM-DD}} (the picked day).
* [ ] Edit the address to a later {{asOfDate}} (e.g. 2027-01-01) → the report opens on today.

h3. Location [S5-R2–S5-R10, S5-R6a, S5-N1, S5-E1]

* The Location menu lists every location with open documents in this report on the as-of date, whatever location you are signed into, named as in the top-right switcher. "Select all", "N selected", "Clear selection". All ticked → "Location: All locations".
* Untick one → rows, counts, totals, buckets and exports narrow to documents at the ticked locations. The chip names one location, or reads "N locations".
* A/P: a bill counts at its delivery's location; a vendor credit from a return at the return's; any other vendor credit at the vendor's.
* Clear selection → "Location: No locations" (grey): "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters", no Totals, no Location column; export → "Empty export".
* A/R Collection's list leaves out a location whose only open invoices are not yet due (Product confirmed).
* An organization with one location: no Location chip.

h3. As of change and ticked locations [S5-E3]

* Setup: 3 locations with open documents today, and an earlier date on which one of them (C) had nothing open.
* All ticked → change As of to that date → still "Location: All locations".
* Tick A and C → change As of → only A stays ticked.
* Tick only C → change As of → back to "Location: All locations".
* "No locations" → change As of → stays "No locations".
* If one location is left ticked, the Location column hides and a Location sort falls back to the opening order (SV-11532).

h3. Past due ranges [S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18]

* [ ] Tick 31-60 → only invoices / bills in that range stay, plus *every* credit memo, deposit and vendor credit. The other Detail buckets keep only their credits or read "(0)".
* [ ] Ranges use calendar days at the location: a document due exactly 31 days before the as-of date is in 31-60.
* [ ] Summaries with ranges ticked: only customers / vendors with an amount in those ranges remain, at full balances.
* [ ] The Totals row = the sum of the rows left, on every page and in both exports.

h3. Summary = Detail [S5-R18a, S5-R18b]

* Past due Any, same As of, customer and locations: A/R Summary Totals = A/R Detail Open Balance Totals, bucket by bucket (Current included). A/P Summary = A/P Detail likewise. Do not compare the Amount column.
* Record a payment, reload → the new figures show.

h3. Address and drill-down [S5-R10, S5-R10a, S5-R11, S5-R14, S5-R19, S5-N2, S5-N3]

* [ ] Tick filters, then reload, press Back, or paste the link in a new tab → the same chips come back.
* [ ] A link with {{locationIds=a,b}} works; an unknown location id or {{pastDue=5}} is ignored (All / Any). A deleted customer id next to a valid one → opens with the valid one, no error toast.
* [ ] A/R Summary: set As of, Past due 31-60 and two locations → click a customer name → A/R Collection opens for that customer (named on the chip) with the same As of, Past due and locations. A/P Summary → A/P Unpaid likewise.
* [ ] An old bookmark with {{?customerId=}} / {{?vendorId=}} still opens filtered to that customer / vendor.
* [ ] Open A/R Collection from A/R Summary for a customer that is NOT among the first 50 names in the Customer list (e.g. one starting with a late letter) → the Customer chip shows the customer's name, never "Customer: 1 unavailable" (fixed in review round 2, SV-11315 SR-13).
* [ ] Opening a report from the menu → today, All, Any, All locations.
* [ ] A location chosen, then a customer with nothing there → empty, Location chip still visible.
* [ ] Switch location top right while on a report → same filters and rows; sort back to the opening order; groups collapse; back to the top.

h3. Loading [S8-R5]

* Reload a report on a large organization → the loading bar shows while the filters are read; it never flashes "No record matches these filters" first.

h2. Known mismatches (not bugs)

* PRD S5-E3 does not mention "No locations"; the build keeps it (Product agreed, wording fix pending).
* *Follow-up:* "today" comes from the browser's time zone data. Between 00:00 and 01:00 Edmonton time, a browser with out-of-date data opens on yesterday and does not offer today in the picker. A picked date is always honoured.
* A location whose record has no organization set shows no name (kept; stricter than the old reports).

h2. What is NOT impacted

* Filters on other reports (Sales By Customer, Inventory Value, Work In Progress): the shared chips changed opt-in; see SV-11597.

h2. Dev verification

* [x] Tests: {{useAgingReportFilters.spec.ts}} (sends the picked day; a later day in a link is ignored; S5-E3), {{useFilterUrlSync.spec.ts}}, {{useReportFilters.spec.ts}}, {{FilterChip.spec.ts}}, {{FilterOptionListPanel.spec.ts}}, {{FilterSearchListPanel.spec.ts}}, {{ValidOrganizationScopeValidatorTest}} (foreign or unknown ids → 400), {{DbalAgingLocationOptionsQueryRepositoryTest}}, {{AgingSummaryDetailParityTest}} (S5-R18a), {{AgingSqlTest}} (calendar-day ranges).
* [x] Review rounds: phases 1–5 and asof-r2, all approved.
* [x] Walks: drill-down keeps As of, Past due and locations; p5walk 13/13; SV-12137 loading check passes; video 17/17 checks.
